entities.summary: Joseph Amos Hermas "Butch" Arbour was a Canadian professional ice hockey player. A left winger, Arbour played two seasons in the National Hockey Association and six seasons in the National Hockey League for Montreal Canadiens, Hamilton Tigers and Toronto St. Patricks. Arbour was a member of the Montreal Canadiens 1916 Stanley Cup-winning team.
